arxiv-2106-00781.title: Following the Lithium: Tracing Li-bearing Molecules Across Age, Mass, and Gravity in Brown Dwarfs
arxiv-2106-00781.creator: Ehsan Gharib-Nezhad, Mark S. Marley, Natasha E. Batalha, Channon Visscher, Richard S. Freedman, Roxana E. Lupu
arxiv-2106-00781.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Ehsan Gharib-Nezhad, Mark S. Marley, Natasha E. Batalha, Channon Visscher, Richard S. Freedman, Roxana E. Lupu. Lithium is an important element for the understanding of ultracool dwarfs because it is lost to fusion at masses above ∼ 68 ​ M J \sim 68\,M_{\rm J} . Hence, the presence or absence of atomic Li has served as an indicator of the nearby H-burning boundary at about 75 ​ M J 75\,M_{\rm J} between brown-dwarfs and very low-mass stars.

arxiv-2111-08323.title: On the number of non-isomorphic (simple) k k -gonal biembeddings of complete multipartite graphs
arxiv-2111-08323.creator: Simone Costa, Anita Pasotti
arxiv-2111-08323.description: Abstract . This article aims to provide exponential lower bounds on the number of non-isomorphic k k -gonal biembeddings of the complete multipartite graph into orientable surfaces. For this purpose, we use the concept, introduced by Archdeacon in 2015, of Heffer array and its relations with graph embeddings.

arxiv-2201-06026.title: Toward Among-Device AI from On-Device AI with Stream Pipelines Conference: The 44th International Conference on Software Engineering; May 21–29, 2022; Pittsburgh, PA, USA
arxiv-2201-06026.creator: MyungJoo Ham, Sangjung Woo, Jaeyun Jung, Wook Song, Gichan Jang, Yongjoo Ahn, Hyoung Joo Ahn
arxiv-2201-06026.description: Abstract . Modern consumer electronic devices often provide intelligence services with deep neural networks. We have started migrating the computing locations of intelligence services from cloud servers (traditional AI systems) to the corresponding devices (on-device AI systems). On-device AI systems generally have the advantages of preserving privacy, removing network latency, and saving cloud costs.

arxiv-2211-00980.title: Balancing Utility and Fairness in Submodular Maximization
arxiv-2211-00980.creator: Yanhao Wang, Yuchen Li, Francesco Bonchi, Ying Wang
arxiv-2211-00980.description: Abstract . Submodular function maximization is a fundamental combinatorial optimization problem with plenty of applications – including data summarization, influence maximization, and recommendation. In many of these problems, the goal is to find a solution that maximizes the average utility over all users, for each of whom the utility is defined by a monotone submodular function.

arxiv-2211-11308.title: Novel transfer learning schemes based on Siamese networks and synthetic data
arxiv-2211-11308.creator: Philip Kenneweg*, Dominik Stallmann*, Barbara Hammer * with equal contribution
arxiv-2211-11308.description: Abstract Transfer learning schemes based on deep networks which have been trained on huge image corpora offer state-of-the-art technologies in computer vision. Here, supervised and semi-supervised approaches constitute efficient technologies which work well with comparably small data sets. Yet, such applications are currently restricted to application domains where suitable deep network models are readily available.

arxiv-2305-17704.title: RF SSSL by an Autonomous UAV with Two-Ray Channel Model and Dipole Antenna Patterns Thanks: This research is supported in part by the NSF award CNS-1939334.
arxiv-2305-17704.creator: Hyeokjun Kwon, Sung Joon Maeng, and Ismail Guvenc
arxiv-2305-17704.description: Abstract Advancements in unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) technology have led to their increased utilization in various commercial and military applications. One such application is signal source search and localization (SSSL) using UAVs, which offers significant benefits over traditional ground-based methods due to improved RF signal reception at higher altitudes and inherent autonomous 3D navigation capabilities.

arxiv-2309-01956.title: Liouville equations on complete surfaces with nonnegative Gauss curvature Thanks: Lai’s research is supported by NSFC No. 12031012, No. 12171313 and the Institute of Modern Analysis-A Frontier Research Center of Shanghai. Cai’s research is supported by NSFC No.12171313.
arxiv-2309-01956.creator: Xiaohan Cai, Mijia Lai
arxiv-2309-01956.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Xiaohan Cai, Mijia Lai. We study finite total curvature solutions of the Liouville equation Δ ​ u + e 2 ​ u = 0 \Delta u+e^{2u}=0 on a complete surface ( M , g ) (M,g) with nonnegative Gauss curvature.

arxiv-2310-11573.title: A polynomial bound on the number of minimal separators and potential maximal cliques in P 6 P_{6} -free graphs of bounded clique number
arxiv-2310-11573.creator: Marcin Pilipczuk, Paweł Rzążewski
arxiv-2310-11573.description: Abstract In this note we show a polynomial bound on the number of minimal separators and potential maximal cliques in P 6 P_{6} -free graphs of bounded clique number. † † dmtcs-publicationdata: Volume vol. 27:2 (2025), #10, doi:10.46298/dmtcs.12438 1 Introduction Let G be a graph.

arxiv-2403-05508.title: On maximal nowhere dense sublocales Thanks: This paper is part of a Ph.D thesis written under the supervision of Prof. Themba Dube. The author acknowledges and highly appreciates the support he received from his supervisor, and also acknowledges funding from the National Research Foundation of South
arxiv-2403-05508.creator: Mbekezeli Nxumalo
arxiv-2403-05508.description: Abstract . The aim of this paper is to study some variants of nowhere dense sublocales called maximal nowhere dense and homogeneous maximal nowhere dense sublocales. These concepts were initially introduced by Veksler in classical topology. We give some general properties of these sublocales and further examine their relationship with both inaccessible sublocales and remote sublocales.

arxiv-2412-20598.title: Phonon-Induced Effects in Quantum Dot Absorption and Resonance Fluorescence with Hierarchy of Pure States
arxiv-2412-20598.creator: Sebastian Toivonen, Kimmo Luoma
arxiv-2412-20598.description: Abstract We investigate a quantum dot (QD) system coupled to a vibrational environment with a super-Ohmic spectral density and weakly to a leaky cavity mode, a model relevant for semiconductor-based single-photon sources. The phonon coupling induces dephasing and broadens the absorption and emission line shapes, while the weakly coupled cavity mode leads to effective driving of the QD.

arxiv-2502-07780.title: DarwinLM : Evolutionary Structured Pruning of Large Language Models
arxiv-2502-07780.creator: Shengkun Tang, Oliver Sieberling, Eldar Kurtic, Zhiqiang Shen, Dan Alistarh
arxiv-2502-07780.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved significant success across various NLP tasks. However, their massive computational costs limit their widespread use, particularly in real-time applications. Structured pruning offers an effective solution by compressing models and directly providing end-to-end speed improvements, regardless of the hardware environment.

arxiv-2508-05366.title: Notebook for the BioASQ Lab at CLEF 2025
arxiv-2508-05366.creator: Samy Ateia, Udo Kruschwitz
arxiv-2508-05366.description: Abstract Agentic Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and ’deep research’ systems aim to enable autonomous search processes where Large Language Models (LLMs) iteratively refine outputs. However, applying these systems to domain-specific professional search, such as biomedical research, presents challenges, as automated systems may reduce user involvement and misalign with expert information needs.

arxiv-2509-05819.title: Total Faraday rotation by the Hall effect in a 2D electron gas
arxiv-2509-05819.creator: Vishnunarayanan Suresh, Talia J. Martz-Oberlander, Sujatha Vijayakrishnan, Loren N. Pfeiffer, Ken W. West, Guillaume Gervais, Bertrand Reulet, Thomas Szkopek
arxiv-2509-05819.description: Abstract We report the realization of near total Faraday rotation of θ F = 1.43 \theta_{F}=1.43 rad (82 ∘ ) on a single pass through a 2D electron gas (2DEG), approaching the ideal limit of π / 2 \pi/2 rad (90 ∘ ). The corresponding Verdet constant V = 9.

arxiv-2509-16349.title: In Praise of Slowness
arxiv-2509-16349.creator: Etienne Ligout
arxiv-2509-16349.description: Abstract While speed is an ubiquitous concept in physics, its inverse — known as slowness — sometimes proves more relevant. We discuss some case studies within classical physics where such a notion is fruitful, before exploring how it can be realized within the relativistic and thermodynamical frameworks.

arxiv-2601-16719.title: On a Coupled Adoption-Opinion Framework for Competing Innovations This work was supported in part by the Wallenberg AI, Autonomous Systems and Software Program (WASP) funded by the Knut and Alice Wallenberg Foundation, and by the European Union – Next Generation EU, Mission 4, Component 1, under the
arxiv-2601-16719.creator: Martina Alutto, Fabrizio Dabbene, Angela Fontan, Karl H. Johansson, Chiara Ravazzi
arxiv-2601-16719.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose a two-layer adoption-opinion model to study the diffusion of two competing technologies within a population whose opinions evolve under social influence and adoption-driven feedback. After adopting one technology, individuals may become dissatisfied and switch to the alternative.

britannica-1911-panjdeh.title: Panjdeh (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-panjdeh.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-panjdeh.description: Article 'Panjdeh' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 20), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. Murghab at Pul-i-Khishti. In March 1885 when the Russo-Afghan Boundary Commission should have been engaged in settling the boundary-line, this portion of it was in dispute between the Afghans and the Russians. A part of the Afghan force was encamped on the west bank of the Kushk, and on the 29th of March General Komarov sent an ultimatum demanding their withdrawal.

europmc-pmc6425583.title: PAGA: graph abstraction reconciles clustering with trajectory inference through a topology preserving map of single cells.
europmc-pmc6425583.creator: Wolf FA, Hamey FK, Plass M, Solana J, Dahlin JS, Göttgens B, Rajewsky N, Simon L, Theis FJ.
europmc-pmc6425583.description: Single-cell RNA-seq quantifies biological heterogeneity across both discrete cell types and continuous cell transitions. Partition-based graph abstraction (PAGA) provides an interpretable graph-like map of the arising data manifold, based on estimating connectivity of manifold...

plos-pone-0008791.title: Endogenous Morphine Levels Are Increased in Sepsis: A Partial Implication of Neutrophils
plos-pone-0008791.creator: Elise Glattard, Ingeborg D. Welters, Thomas Lavaux et al.
plos-pone-0008791.description: PLOS ONE research article. Mammalian cells synthesize morphine and the respective biosynthetic pathway has been elucidated. Human neutrophils release this alkaloid into the media after exposure to morphine precursors. However, the exact role of endogenous morphine in inflammatory processes remains unclear.

pmc-11442697.title: A novel SOX2 frameshift pathogenic variant located in the transactivation domain in a male infant with hypogonadotropic hypogonadism
pmc-11442697.creator: Ayano Kimura-Yoshida, Takeshi Sato, Yosuke Ichihashi, Masanori Wasa, Satoshi Narumi, Tomohiro Ishii, Tomonobu Hasegawa
pmc-11442697.description: c development and plays a critical role in the development of the eye, forebrain, and hypothalamus. SOX2 is a single-exon gene that encodes a 317-amino acid protein with two functional domains: DNA-binding and transactivation (1). Heterozygous pathogenic variants of SOX2 cause ocular manifestations, including clinical anophthalmia or microphthalmia in most patients and hypogonadotropic hypogonadism (HH) in some patients.

pmc-11454676.title: 8105 Radiation-Induced Hyperthyroidism in the Context of Palliative Radiation Therapy
pmc-11454676.creator: A Randhawa, G Palaguachi, J G Karam
pmc-11454676.description: Disclosure: A. Randhawa: None. G. Palaguachi: None. J.G. Karam: None. Introduction: Palliative radiotherapy, designed to alleviate focal symptoms in advanced, incurable cancer, aims to enhance quality of life with minimal treatment burden. The thyroid gland's susceptibility to neck radiation is known, primarily leading to hypothyroidism. However, hyperthyroidism is a much less frequently reported adverse effect that is poorly understood.

pmc-11508968.title: Insecticide Resistance in Aedes aegypti from the National Capital Region of the Philippines
pmc-11508968.creator: Richard Paul B Malijan, Jason R Angeles, Ariza Minelle A Apilado, Mary Ann T Ammugauan, Ferdinand V Salazar, Shun-Fan Wu
pmc-11508968.description: Simple SummaryThe National Capital Region (NCR), Philippines, reports one of the country’s highest dengue incidences. Apart from being populous and the center of economic activity, the local government authorities of this region have undertaken significant vector control efforts devoted to dengue. The use of insecticides to reduce mosquito vector density remains the handiest control method.

pmc-11560386.title: Trustworthiness, Value, Danger, and Readability of ChatGPT-Generated Responses to Health Questions Related to Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension
pmc-11560386.creator: Murat Kerkütlüoğlu, Erhan Kaya, Rasim Gökmen
pmc-11560386.description: Aim: To enhance outcomes for patients with pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH), comprehensive and individualized therapy is needed. A large language model called Generative Pre-trained Transformer (ChatGPT) has the ability to provide expert yet patient-friendly care. We wanted to determine how well ChatGPT could accurately and consistently respond to inquiries on knowledge and management for PAH.

pmc-12432608.title: Beyond the tumor: towards a cachexia-based host phenotype through body composition analysis in patients with resectable lung cancer
pmc-12432608.creator: Koen C. H. A. Verkoulen, Lars Geenen, Aimée J. P. M. Franssen, Anne M. A. Verzijl, Yvonne L. J. Vissers, Karel W. E. Hulsewé, Juliette H. R. J. Degens, David P. J. van Dijk, Erik R. de Loos
pmc-12432608.description: Cancer cachexia, characterized by involuntary weight loss and extensive muscle and adipose tissue wasting, is a major contributor to morbidity and mortality in cancer patients. To date, no effective medical intervention can completely reverse this multifactorial syndrome, which is driven by different metabolic changes.

pmc-12474181.title: Preliminary Findings on Low-Dose 1cp-LSD for Canine Anxiety: Exploring the Role of Owner Neuroticism and Psychopathology
pmc-12474181.creator: Elisa Hernández-Álvarez, Jaime Rojas-Hernández, Lucas F. Borkel, Domingo J. Quintana-Hernández, Tobías Fernández-Borkel, Luis Alberto Henríquez-Hernández
pmc-12474181.description: Simple SummaryThis study explored whether small oral doses of 1cp-LSD, a legal prodrug of LSD, could help reduce anxiety in dogs. Seven anxious dogs were treated over 30 days, and their anxiety levels were evaluated before, after, and one month following treatment.

pmc-12504963.title: Development of a peer support and precision matching mobile platform for health management for people living with HIV
pmc-12504963.creator: Yangfeng Wu, Shuyu Han, Sikai Shan, Xin Xie, Dongmei Li, Lili Zhang, Zhiwen Wang
pmc-12504963.description: ObjectivesThis study aimed to describe the development process of the peer precision-matching and health management mobile platform “Aspark” for people living with human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) (PLWH) and to evaluate its usability.MethodsThe study assembled a multidisciplinary research and development team comprising researchers, software engineers, art designers, clinical nursing specialists, HIV peer volunteers, and psychological counselors.

pmc-12548206.title: Molecular characterization of antimicrobial resistance genes and plasmid profiles in enterobacterales isolated from urinary tract infections in rural outpatient women in Otavalo, Ecuador
pmc-12548206.creator: Fernanda Hernández-Alomía, Carlos Bastidas-Caldes, Antonella Zambrano, Mario Narváez, Pablo Castillejo
pmc-12548206.description: BackgroundThe rise of antibiotic-resistant bacteria poses a significant public health threat, particularly in the context of urinary tract infections (UTIs), which rank as the second most common ambulatory illness. UTIs are often caused by Enterobacterales species, such as Escherichia coli and Klebsiella pneumoniae, with increasing resistance to critical antibiotics complicating treatment.

pmc-12577107.title: Educational needs and barriers in dementia care training for migrant family care assistants in Italy: a qualitative study
pmc-12577107.creator: Sara Santini, Antonella Golino, Daniela Grignoli, Flavia Galassi, Georgia Casanova, Serena Cancellieri, Ilaria Chirico, Sara Trolese, Veronica Moretti, Riccardo Pronzato, Rabih Chattat
pmc-12577107.description: BackgroundIn Italy, migrant family care assistants (MFCAs) represent the most cost-effective answer to dementia home care need and to desire of ageing in place of older adults and family caregivers. Nevertheless, MFCAs very often have no training in elder care and even less in the dementia care. Conversely, elder care training may improve MFCAs’ working condition and mental health.

pmc-12669602.title: Tunable optoelectronic properties of reduced graphene oxide superlattices intercalated with poly(2-amino-1-mercaptobenzene) for Van der Waals photonic heterostructures
pmc-12669602.creator: Amira Ben Gouider Trabelsi, Fedor V. Kusmartsev, Fatemah H. Alkallas, Asmaa M. Elsayed, Mohamed Rabia
pmc-12669602.description: We have discovered a novel class of van der Waals (vdW) materials composed of reduced graphene oxide (rGO) superlattices that can be intercalated with various polymeric compounds. The bandgap in these groundbreaking graphene oxide-derived materials can be modulated and set by altering the reduced oxygen concentration and varying the intercalating agent’s quantity.

pmc-12702224.title: Ecofriendly algal extracellular polymeric substance-based nanobiocomposite for photodegradation of bisphenol A
pmc-12702224.creator: Bikramjit Bhattacharya, Abhrajit Debroy, Dhivya Viswanathan, Feeba Nissi Anandraj, KrishnaRao Eswar Neerugatti, Amitava Mukherjee
pmc-12702224.description: SummaryBisphenol A (BPA), a common plasticizer and an emerging pollutant is found in the water bodies due to the degradation of microplastics. The present work studies the efficiency of algal extracellular polymeric substance (EPS)-based zeolite/nanoceria nanobiocomposite for the degradation of BPA. Zeolite was heat/acid activated for deposition of photoactive CeO2 nanoparticles.

pmc-13556338.title: Host OTUB2 and viral PLpro stabilize NSP8 to promote SARS-CoV-2 replication
pmc-13556338.creator: Wenying Gao, Hongfei Wang, Jingguo Xin, Chenjia Gu, Lu Qiu, Xue Zhang, Chunlei Wang, Qingxiang Zhang, Shuai Li, Guangquan Li, Wenyan Zhang

pmc-13583754.title: Characterising the pharmacokinetics of olanzapine in patients with anorexia nervosa (TORPEDO): protocol for a multicentre cross-sectional study
pmc-13583754.creator: Jiayi Liang, Bram Dierckx, Gwen C Dieleman, Tessa M Bosch, Birgit C P Koch, Brenda C M De Winter
pmc-13583754.description: AbstractIntroductionAnorexia nervosa (AN) is a debilitating eating disorder with one of the highest mortality rates of all psychiatric disorders. The lifetime prevalence rates of AN might be up to 4% among females and 0.3% among males. According to a systematic review, the pooled incidence rate of AN in females is 8.8 per 100 000 person-years; 95% CI 7.8 to 9.8.

pmc-13593049.title: Exploring therapeutic targets for hepatocellular carcinoma through druggable genes
pmc-13593049.creator: Chao Tang, Shuangjing Zhu, Zhen Ding
pmc-13593049.description: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) ranks as the third leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide. Mendelian randomization (MR) has emerged as a powerful approach for therapeutic target identification in HCC. In this study, we applied two-sample MR to assess the causal effects of multiple genes on HCC risk.

pmc-13606608.title: Genetic Diversity and Selection Signatures of Two North American Corriente Cattle Herds in Northeastern New Mexico, United States
pmc-13606608.creator: Maximiliano J. Spetter, Richard E. Estell, Eileen M. Armstrong, Craig A. Gifford, Felipe A. Rodríguez Almeida, Eugenio Jara, Andrew Cox, Pablo J. Ross, Andrés R. Perea, Micah Funk, Andrés F. Cibils, Santiago A. Utsumi
pmc-13606608.description: The North American Corriente (NAC) is a Criollo-derived cattle breed raised primarily in the Southwestern and Great Plains regions of the United States for rodeo sports and beef production. Despite the substantial practical knowledge surrounding the breed, available information on the genomic makeup of NAC cattle remains limited.
